notes.title: First female Presidents of the USA and France in history!
notes.notes:
On February 15, two women were elected to the highest position in their respective countries: Democrat Riley Miller in the United States and Social-Democrat Aurélie Kal in France. What does it mean for these two countries? Will there be a more economically interventionist State in the US? Will Aurélie Kal ensure continuity of the policy introduced by her predecessor who came from the same coalition?

Read the whole article on the official Facebook page:
https://www.facebook.com/pages/World-Of-Leaders/1376227812682484

notes.title: 1.25 Update
notes.notes:
1.25 Update has been released. 
See below the main changes:

-correction of limitation for voting to political party's internal elections
-correcting/adapting server's messages language to client's (player's) language
-adding a fullsceen mode toggle option
-setting characters names displays always in 'first-last'
-update of user manuals
-correction incorrect display of too long discussion threads
-correction of specific crashes when using the 'detailed display' icon

notes.title: Presentation video added
notes.notes:
A presentation video has just been added to the game page: it describes the main gameplay aspects and features of the game.

A few players report having got crashes: we invite them to report this to us on support@eversim.com with, if possible, a quick desciption of their configuration and how/where they get it, this would help us to track and correct them.

Richard, Eversim support.
